title: Passkey Registration Flow
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Frontend
    participant Backend
    participant IBM Verify
    participant Browser WebAuthn

    User->>Frontend: Enter registration details
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /api/auth/passkey/register/options
    Backend->>Backend: Generate registration options
    Backend-->>Frontend: WebAuthn options
    Frontend->>Browser WebAuthn: navigator.credentials.create()
    Browser WebAuthn->>User: Prompt to create passkey
    User->>Browser WebAuthn: Confirm & provide biometric/PIN
    Browser WebAuthn-->>Frontend: Credential
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /api/auth/passkey/register/verify
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /oauth2/token
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Admin token
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/Users
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Create user with passkey credentials
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: User created
    Backend-->>Frontend: Success response
    Frontend->>Frontend: Redirect to sign-in
